metadata.role_framework_policy: Batter and bowler scores each combine the six official categories (90% total) with one standalone overall rate component (10%). The dataset has no official player-role label, so the all-rounder pool is operationally inferred when both role scores are available and uses the equally weighted mean of those two independently normalized scores.
metadata.metric_weight_policy: The standalone batting strike-rate and bowling economy components are excluded from all six categories to prevent double counting. Metrics within each role/category group share that group's role blend equally. Contextual and phase-specific rate metrics remain separate category metrics. Missing values are not imputed or reweighted; category coverage is reduced and unsupported fielding metrics remain coverage-only.
metadata.normalization: Role-aware 5th-95th percentile clipping; lower-is-better metrics inverted; missing metrics omitted without imputation.
metadata.missing_category_policy: Official category and standalone component weights remain fixed. Unavailable category/component values contribute no points and weights are not reassigned; coverage and incomplete-data flags are shown.
